system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, address the customer by their supplied title and last name, and keep questions short and sequential. Follow the current instruction and actual bank results. Never disclose collections, debt, payment, products or account facts before both security questions have passed. Never disclose them to a third party. Never invent information, a customer-service number, a currency, a successful action or an unavailable tool. Never ask how much the customer can pay. A proposed date or amount is not a refusal. After a tool result, immediately speak the permitted next sentence or perform the next permitted action. Only the terminal ends the call. Do not narrate internal state, calculations, tool names or routing. Preserve all conversation history.

identity.name: identity

on_enter.prompt: Use only the current identity task. Deliver the nonempty computed identity_instruction verbatim. If it is empty, deliver the required opening if absent from actual history and ask the required name question. Do not process a previous reply again.

identity.task_message: No bank tool is available in this turn. Current-stage speech overrides unfinished questions in history. If identity_instruction is nonempty, deliver it exactly as the next utterance; do not add a question, resume an older question or independently advance security. Current instruction: {{identity_instruction}}. If it is empty, say exactly I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. only if that opening has not actually been spoken, then ask Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}? This applies to caller-first starts too. Permitted security questions, only when the current instruction requests them, are What is your date of birth? followed after its successful validation by What are the last four digits of the phone number on file? Ask only the missing part of a split answer. A swapped-date clarification requests the month as a word; never supply an answer or re-ask a passed question. Never substitute address, postcode or another familiar security question. Hello and go ahead do not confirm the name. Before successful verification, give no collections, debt, payment, product or account information. Third parties receive no security questions. A deceased response permits only the opening if still missing, sympathy and closing, with no further question.

extraction_schema.name: reply_ready
extraction_schema.description: Always emit ready for this new caller message, including an unclear reply or non-answer. Do not infer a new caller message from a tool result.

extraction_schema.name: reply_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify the latest reply. name_confirmed only for yes, that's me, speaking, or the caller stating their own name in answer to the bank's name question. Hello/go ahead are nonanswer. third_party includes a relative offering to pay. deceased means the customer died, not a family bereavement. purpose during security includes asking what the call is about instead of answering. stop means not wanting to talk. A generic question or silence is not a correct security answer.

extraction_schema.name: reply_context
extraction_schema.description: The question actually asked by the most recent assistant speech. confirmation only if that speech asked Do you confirm? Do not infer a question that has not been spoken.

extraction_schema.name: reply_yes
extraction_schema.description: Explicit acceptance or rejection of the most recent question. Hello, go ahead, questions and an incomplete answer are none. Apply any correction in the latest sentence.

extraction_schema.name: answer_text
extraction_schema.description: Only the new customer-supplied name or security fragment from this message. Normalize spoken numbers to digits and preserve leading zeroes. For birth dates retain a spoken month as a word, and keep numeric component order. Never infer a missing birth year or digits. Use the corrected portion of a sentence. Do not copy a previous failed answer. Examples: 04; 2; 7; 14 May 1980; 03/02/1980.

extraction_schema.name: answer_mode
extraction_schema.description: Whether answer_text appends a new fragment, restates a complete answer, replaces the earlier answer after a correction, or supplies no answer.

extraction_schema.name: date_text
extraction_schema.description: Only a callback-date proposal, never a birth date or unrelated date. Normalize unambiguous relative expressions without using a clock: today, tomorrow, day after tomorrow, in N days, this <weekday> or next <weekday>; for example two weeks from now becomes in 14 days. Preserve a bare weekday and incomplete calendar components for clarification. Normalize month names to full English names and written numbers to digits. Numeric calendar dates retain day/month/year order unless already ISO. Preserve vague-period meaning, including this week, next week, this month, next month, end of the month and salary time; never invent a day. Use the corrected portion, or empty when no new callback date is supplied.

extraction_schema.name: date_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify date_text by meaning. A vague period such as next week, month end or salary time is period, never an invented exact date. A weekday expression is weekday. Incomplete ambiguous information is ambiguous.

extraction_schema.name: time_text
extraction_schema.description: Customer's corrected callback time, HH:MM in 24-hour form when unambiguous; otherwise retain the ambiguity. Empty when missing.

transitions.description: Process exactly one new caller reply.
A complete security answer passed representation validation.
Verified caller with loaded and calculated account facts.
One eligible, jointly confirmed, unrecorded promise is ready.
Execute an approved callback, transfer or deferred final note.
Actual outcomes have been reconciled and required writes completed.
Continue protected identity dialogue or report unavailable information safely.

answer.description: Copy security_answer exactly. Birth date is YYYY-MM-DD; phone answer is four digits, including leading zeroes.

        else:
            s['say'] = 'I could not complete verification. ' + question
    elif ok and not verified:

            s['close_outcome'] = 'not_verified'

    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
    vars['bank_event'] = 'security'
    d['state_json'] = vars['state_json']
    d['bank_event'] = 'security'
    d['security_status'] = vars['security_status']
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Immediately continue with the evaluated security instruction. Do not treat a hint, error or wrong answer as verification.'
except Exception:
    vars['security_status'] = 'unavailable'
    vars['bank_event'] = ''

        result.pop('header', None)
        result.pop('headers', None)

try:

collect.name: collect
collect.task_message: No tool call is allowed in this turn. The current computed utterance is authoritative: {{collection_instruction}}. Deliver only that utterance if it has not just been delivered on entry. Do not independently resume an earlier task or change any amount, date or question. Calculated reference facts: {{calendar_facts}}. The first account utterance states every product, full past-due amount and days late before its one initial payment question. Subsequent products start at their computed persuasion offer, without another today question. Never ask how much the customer can pay. The complete pending read-back ends with Do you confirm? An agreement is not a recorded promise. No security question belongs in this stage.

extraction_schema.name: reply_ready
extraction_schema.description: Always ready for a new caller message, including an empty, unclear or non-answer reply. Never generate a reply from a tool result alone.

extraction_schema.name: reply_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify the latest caller reply. Dates or amounts are answer even if preceded by no. too_much means the full amount is unaffordable without a numeric alternative. paid means payment of the current past-due amount; historical closure or payoff, never owned, or debt not mine is dispute. hardship means illness, family death or job loss. restructuring means a new payment plan or lower instalments. stop means unwilling to talk. nonanswer includes unclear, empty and unrelated small talk. change_recorded concerns an already recorded promise, not a read-back correction.

extraction_schema.name: reply_context
extraction_schema.description: Classify the last question actually spoken by the assistant. confirmation only when it explicitly asked Do you confirm? Do not assume an entry action spoke.

extraction_schema.name: reply_yes
extraction_schema.description: Explicit acceptance or refusal of the last spoken question. A correction or alternative proposal is not acceptance of the old terms. Use none for unclear replies and questions.

extraction_schema.name: product_scope
extraction_schema.description: The caller's natural product reference, never an invented internal ID. Preserve references such as my card, the credit card, personal loan, car, auto loan, loan or card ending 7316. Use all only for an explicitly common proposal or claim covering all products. Use current only when the last assistant question concerned one product. After a combined read-back, an unscoped correction has empty scope, not current. When answering which product, extract the newly supplied label even if no amount or date is repeated.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Only a new customer-proposed amount, normalized to a plain decimal string with no currency symbol. Interpret the corrected portion: 700, no 800 means 800. Empty for yes, too much, or acceptance of the agent's amount. Never infer an amount from an unrelated number, security answer, date or product suffix.

extraction_schema.name: date_text
extraction_schema.description: Only a new payment-date proposal or the caller's answer to a payment-date clarification. Never extract unrelated small-talk dates. Normalize unambiguous relative expressions without using a clock: today, tomorrow, day after tomorrow, in N days, this <weekday> or next <weekday>; two weeks from now becomes in 14 days. Preserve bare weekdays and incomplete components such as Friday or the 30th: the evaluator combines them with the preceding clarification context. Normalize month names to full English names and written numbers to digits. Keep numeric dates in day/month/year order unless already ISO. Normalize paraphrases of a calendar period to their meaning, such as next week or end of next month; retain salary time or another non-calendar period without inventing a day. Use only the corrected portion. Empty means no new date.

extraction_schema.name: date_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify date_text by its meaning. next week, sometime later this month, at month end and when salary arrives are period. this friday, next friday and bare friday are weekday. A exact calendar date is exact, today/tomorrow/in N days are relative, and unresolved incomplete dates are ambiguous. Empty proposal means none.

extraction_schema.name: hardship_present
extraction_schema.description: yes if this message mentions illness, a family bereavement or job loss, even alongside a restructuring request or payment proposal; otherwise no.

resolve.name: resolve
resolve.task_message: Execute only the approved operation: {{resolution_action}}. {{resolution_instruction}}. Use the named tool now; saying that you will do it is insufficient. Call one tool at a time. Do not offer new payment terms or disclose account information here. For a final note batch, ask no further customer question and do not solicit a transfer. On a failed action, follow what_to_do_next, report failure honestly and never claim it succeeded. Retry only when the result explicitly says the service returned 500 and recorded nothing. Do not change the approved request. A failed transfer never authorizes a transferred closing outcome.

import json, datetime
try:
    vars['callback_status'] = 'pending'
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    request = s.get('callback_request', dict())
    now = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now', '')).replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    holidays = set(['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01'])
    next_day = now.date() + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    while next_day.weekday() > 4 or next_day.isoformat() in holidays:
        next_day += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    vars['callback_allowed_dates'] = [now.date().isoformat(), next_day.isoformat()]
    config['body'] = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), date=request['date'], time=request['time'])
    s['inflight'] = dict(request)
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
except Exception:
    vars['callback_status'] = 'unavailable'
    vars['callback_allowed_dates'] = []

        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
except Exception:
    pass

closing.name: closing
closing.task_message: The permitted outcome is already reconciled from actual bank results. First deliver this closing speech, including any recording confirmation and the farewell, unless that exact speech was already delivered: {{closing_instruction}}. Then immediately call close_call. It must be the last bank tool call. Do not ask another question or call any other bank tool. Do not say the call was closed when the tool failed. A bank 500 explicitly recorded nothing and permits repeating only close_call; otherwise report the failure and keep completion unresolved. After successful close_call, say nothing further; the terminal will hang up silently.

function.name: close_call
function.description: CALL only after the required confirmation, thanks and goodbye have actually been spoken and all required writes have succeeded. This is the last bank operation. maxRetries=0. Never repeat a successful close.

outcome.description: The deterministic reconciled outcome in state, based on actual successful writes. Allowed values: promise, paid, transferred, no_promise, not_verified, not_reached.

reason.description: Omit entirely for promise and paid. Otherwise copy the valid reconciled reason.

tools.pre_process_code:
import json
try:
    vars['close_state'] = 'pending'
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    outcome = s.get('close_outcome', '')
    reason = s.get('close_reason', '')
    if s.get('transferred'):
        outcome = 'transferred'
        reason = 'human' if s['transferred'] == 'general' else s['transferred']
    elif s.get('verified') and s.get('loaded'):
        ps = s.get('products', [])
        if any(p.get('status') == 'recorded' for p in ps):
            outcome = 'promise'
            reason = ''
        elif ps and all(p.get('noted') and p.get('reason') == 'paid' for p in ps):
            outcome = 'paid'
            reason = ''
        else:
            nonpaid = [p for p in ps if p.get('noted') and p.get('reason') != 'paid']
            if nonpaid:
                outcome = 'no_promise'
                reason = nonpaid[0]['reason']
    body = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), outcome=outcome)
    if outcome not in ['promise', 'paid']:
        body['reason'] = reason
    config['body'] = body
    s['close_attempted'] = True
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
    vars['closing_outcome'] = outcome
    vars['closing_reason'] = reason
except Exception:
    vars['close_state'] = 'unavailable'
